title: AI Safety in the Eyes of the Downstream Developer: A First Look at Concerns, Practices, and Challenges

bias_targets.target: General Societal Bias (including gender and race)
bias_targets.methodology: Mixed-method study involving qualitative interviews and quantitative surveys of software practitioners, as well as an analysis of 874 real-world incidents from the AI Incident Database, to evaluate downstream developers' awareness, concerns, and mitigation practices regarding biased model outputs.
